Most smart lights in your home are probably small bulbs or outlet adapters, but as the market matures, full lighting product lines with native Matter protocol support and Apple Home compatibility are starting to emerge. SwitchBot has recently launched the new SwitchBot RGBICWW ceiling light, which offers extremely high brightness and native Matter support, allowing it to be installed directly in your home's ceiling fixtures.

The HomeKit Weekly column focuses on smart home accessories, automation tips, and information related to Apple's smart home framework.

Native Matter Support and Apple Home Integration

The most notable selling point of this new ceiling light is its out-of-the-box Matter support, requiring no SwitchBot Hub. As long as your Apple TV 4K or HomePod remains connected, it can be added directly to your existing smart home system via a 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi network.

Hardware Size and Brightness

SwitchBot offers two sizes to meet different needs. The 12-inch model is suitable for hallways and bathrooms, with a brightness of 2000 lumens; the larger 15-inch model is better suited for living rooms and bedrooms, with a maximum brightness of up to 3200 lumens. This ceiling light features built-in stepless dimming from 100% to 0%.

Most smart light bulbs can typically only display one color at a time, but this fixture uses RGBIC technology combined with independent chips to simultaneously display multiple colors on the ceiling, creating dynamic lighting effects. If you prefer traditional lighting, the fixture also has built-in independent warm white and cool white LEDs, with color temperature adjustable from 2700K to 6500K. SwitchBot RGBICWW Summary

Using a 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi connection means adding an always-on device to your router and occupying an older frequency band. If Thread wireless functionality were included, response times within the mesh network would be nearly instantaneous. For under $50, you can get a wired-connected, natively Matter-supported fixture—a very cost-effective choice for users looking to permanently upgrade their ceiling lighting.

You can purchase this brand-new SwitchBot RGBICWW on Amazon.
